Teacher Suspended in Jammu and Kashmir Over Harassment Allegations

A government school teacher in Ramban district of Jammu and Kashmir has been suspended following allegations of harassing a female student. The suspension was confirmed by authorities. The specific details of the allegations and the student involved have not been publicly disclosed.
